description: Find MusicAtlas playlists for a user's musical intent. Use this whenever a user asks for playlists based on a mood, theme, genre, activity, vibe, geography, artist, or track. For natural-language requests such as 'playlists about love', 'workout playlists', or 'sad indie', pass the meaningful musical concept as tags. This tool can also find playlists associated with a specific artist or track.

artist_name.description: Artist name when looking up playlists associated with a specific artist.

geo.description: Optional geographic or regional context for playlist discovery.

tags.description: Natural-language playlist theme, mood, genre, activity, or vibe. Examples: 'love', 'workout', 'sad indie'.

track_name.description: Track title when looking up playlists associated with a specific track.

name: find_playlists
title: Find Playlists
